title: Zelenskyy presses for EU decision on using frozen Russia assets to defend Ukraine
summary: Ukrainian president says ‘time to act is now’ as Belgium seeks guarantees from other member states over loan plan EU leaders have swerved a decision on using Russia’s frozen assets to fund Ukraine’s defence, despite a plea from Volodymyr Zelenskyy to take swift action to make Moscow pay for its war. Hopes of agreeing a new way of funding Ukraine’s war effort were dashed after opposition from Belgium, which hosts most of the Russian central bank funds immobilised in the EU at the Brussels-based institution Euroclear.
